description: This Java source file defines the `ProductConfigWorker` class, which provides utility methods for managing product configuration in an e-commerce system using the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving, filling, storing, and loading product configuration wrappers, as well as handling configuration caching, persistence, and variant product selection logic.

classes.name: ProductConfigWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing product configuration wrappers, caching, persistence, and variant handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductConfigWrapper instance for a given product ID, considering catalog, website, store, and currency context. Uses caching to optimize repeated access.

methods.name: fillProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Populates a ProductConfigWrapper with user-selected options and comments based on the incoming HTTP request parameters.

methods.name: storeProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Stores the current product configuration into the persistence layer, either updating an existing configuration or creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: loadProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Creates and loads a ProductConfigWrapper based on a configuration ID, suitable for reloading saved configurations.
